question: What should I practice for my shooting arm?

runs.text:
Use one focus for this practice set so you can tell what feels different.

General practice option. The available evidence is too limited to identify a personal adjustment.

Give the ball a repeatable lift.

Record another set from the same spot and angle. I’ll review the movement across attempts and track makes separately when outcomes are available.
